basis: Reliability discount applied before noisy-OR fusion. Speech is exact — the word was said or it was not. Vision is inferential and VLMs hallucinate objects. Audio DSP is a proxy for a proxy.
coverage_scaling: Each weight is further scaled by that agent's actual coverage. A vision confidence of 0.9 from an agent that reached 42% of keyframes is not worth 0.9, and reporting it as such claims certainty the run never earned.
